title: I Took the Family Group Chat Through Three Holidays Before I Dropped the Screenshots

parts.text: Thanksgiving, they voted in the chat to host at my apartment because I was "the one with space," then assigned me the turkey, the chairs, and the cleaning. I was thirty-two. I said I could do chairs. They said don't be difficult. I saved the thread. The turkey burned because three people added butter in secret. They blamed my oven. I photographed the butter wrappers in the trash that was not mine. The chat said next year would be easier.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They already scheduled next year in my kitchen while blaming my oven.

social.video_title: They assigned me a turkey and then sabotaged it with secret butter — Part 1/3
social.description: Space, chairs, wrappers in a stranger-to-me trash. Next year already booked. Would you have hosted anyway?

parts.text: Christmas, they used the same chat to tell cousins I was skipping because I was "in a mood," while I was in the parking lot with pies. I walked in. The pies landed. I did not smile for the photo they wanted for Facebook. I smiled for the pies. Uncle Ray asked if I was going to be like this all year. I said I was collecting. He laughed. I saved that too. New Year's invitations went only to people who had laughed. I was not on the list. I was on a screenshot folder titled year.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: New Year's excluded me in writing after they used my pies at Christmas.

social.video_title: They told the cousins I was skipping while I was in the lot with pies — Part 2/3
social.description: Parking-lot pies, Facebook smile refused, a year folder. Would you have gone to New Year's anyway?

parts.text: In January I dropped a single PDF into the chat: assignments, butter, pies, exclusion. I did not editorialize. I muted the thread. Three aunts called my mother. My mother said I had been harsh. Harsh is a PDF of their words. I host nothing now unless I invite. Thanksgiving at a restaurant tastes like not being a venue. The folder is archived. The mute holds. Family can find me by phone, which requires choosing me on purpose. I like purpose. I like pie I don't have to carry through a lie.

social.video_title: The PDF was just their year, stapled — Part 3/3
social.description: Muted thread, restaurant turkey, phone-only. Was a kitchen a personality?
